einzeiler: Michael Steele breaks down the massive anti-Trump election wave and the future of the GOP.
kurzfassung: Tim Miller and former RNC chair Michael Steele celebrate the surprising results of the recent midterms, analyzing the widespread rejection of Trumpism across the country. They examine historic Democratic gains in states like Texas and Georgia, and discuss the deep fractures and future prospects within the Republican Party. The conversation also touches on the absurdity of recent conservative media narratives and foreign policy missteps in Washington.
stichpunkte: Tim Miller and Michael Steele celebrate the widespread popular repudiation of Trumpism in the recent elections.
Steele emphasizes that the election results demonstrate a strong desire for accountability, affordability, and a rejection of cultural division.
The hosts discuss major Democratic breakthroughs and surprising down-ballot wins in conservative strongholds like Texas and Georgia.
They analyze the potential of the national popular vote interstate compact to fundamentally change presidential elections by 2028.
Steele fiercely criticizes Republicans who enabled Trump over the last decade and now attempt to distance themselves from his policies.
The discussion highlights the changing demographics and diverse leadership emerging in southern state governments, particularly regarding women of color in statewide office.
Miller reviews clips from Fox News showing commentators struggling to spin the election losses and pivoting to bizarre cultural topics.
They debate the future of the Republican Party, evaluating potential successors like J.D. Vance and Marco Rubio amidst deep internal factionalism.

clips.text: The election outcome is described as a massive, overwhelming rejection of the current political establishment that will be mourned by its supporters for a very long time.
The effort to establish a direct national popular vote is closer than ever, needing only a small margin of additional electoral votes to reach the threshold.

clips.text: The absurdity of the administration hosting foreign officials and accepting artwork associated with displaced minors while ignoring ongoing conflicts.

beschreibung:
The MAGA coalition is falling apart, Fox News is flummoxed, and Trump is having to grapple with being rejected by huge swaths of America. Steele only has double birds for Republicans who played along with the 10-year hijacking of the party and are now trying to clean up their act. And in a way, the country gave double birds to the administration over DEI, based on the diverse slate of candidates who’ve won statewide office all over the place. Plus: Texas is the whole enchilada for Republicans, electing the president via the national popular vote is looking more possible, Marco leaving the administration would be consistent with how calculating he’s always been, and Tim’s 2012 autopsy was not wrong, just early.
Michael Steele joins Tim for the (much gloating!) weekend pod.
